$comment: Single source of truth for narration. Feeds three consumers: scripts/generate-audio.mjs (ElevenLabs input), scripts/generate-captions.mjs (.srt/.vtt), and the Captions component (open captions burned into the picture). Edit here, never downstream. Times are seconds from the start of the film. 'tts' is what ElevenLabs is asked to say — it uses phonetic spellings ('Ally-loop') and expanded numerals where the model mispronounces the written form; 'cues[].text' is what a viewer reads, and always uses the real spelling.

voice.$comment: Slower than promo standard, because pace is a cognitive-accessibility issue and the film argues for exactly that. 0.92 was the first setting; at that speed the written lines totalled ~151s against a 171s film, which left almost no silence and defeated the point. The lines were cut rather than the delivery rushed, and 0.96 buys back the rest.
